page.layout: One title page, one block of centred lines; a torn fragment of a neighbouring page at the left edge (not transcribed).
page.notes: Title page with large display capitals; the title block is set in mixed roman, italic and black-letter-style display type. Strip of the adjacent page visible at left edge with fragments of marginal print, not legible and not transcribed. Ornamental rule at right edge is a binding or shadow, not text. "Tractatus" is printed with a ligature for "ct" (rendered here as "Tractatus"); "VIRTUTE" line shows the letters as printed with a worn U/V.
